What...!?
"It's only a matter of time before they fire the second shot..."
"What about you? If you can hack into Veda from the Terminal Unit, we can still pull this off, right?"
That's just it, we can't... Our route has been blocked off too.
"...Haah, I see... Now we're in real trouble."
We should change our plan. Let's make rescuing Cherudim and the others our priority.

"...Not bad. Looks like the cannon's turret itself is sticking out of the Cube."
"Hit it there, and we should be able to stop it firing. Even with the risk, it's worth the gamble!!"
Everyone, I'm asking you to stake it all on this chance.
...Understood. If we're doing this, I'll see it through without fail.

"...I'll send the particle cannon's position data over to the Ride Machine!!"
There's no time! We're heading out into the Ride Dungeon right now to hit the particle cannon!!
The Psycho Gundam Mk-II may show up, but our objective is the particle cannon, and nothing else.

notes.note: Leader block #0.99-113 (TextIdOffset+98+k), chain order from 0618.bla: 00, Wing Zero, God, Nu, Zeta, Zero, Mebius, Taro, Seven, Ultraman, OOO, W (Shotaro), Den-O (Momotaros), RX, Rider 1. So #0.103-105 (casual 'kono mama ja') = Zeta, Zero, Mebius; all variants 'At this rate...' as in story_114.
Momotaros variant of the same block (rough 'maitta na... dou surya ii n da').
Comm beep; double-quoted caps per SFX style. Not shown with a speaker name.
Comm lines in corner brackets rendered in double quotes (precedent for bracketed audio). 'Bouei-mou' = enemy defenses.
Terminal Unit and Veda per earlier slices. Subject 'you' restored for the hacking; 'nantoka naru' -> 'we can still pull this off'.

Leader block #0.123-137 (TextIdOffset+122+k), same order: 00, Wing Zero, God, Nu, Zeta, Zero, Mebius, Taro, Seven, Ultraman, OOO, W (Shotaro), Den-O (Momotaros), RX, Rider 1. Wording fits (#0.125 Domon 'kou shite wa oren', #0.128 Zero rough, #0.129/#0.133 polite = Mebius/OOO, #0.135 Momotaros 'oi!'). Identical Japanese -> identical English.
Seravee: exit the Cube through the Ride Gate the Mk-II broke open (story_114 #0.47) and hit the cannon from outside.

Leader block #0.140-154 (TextIdOffset+139+k), same order; the script swaps in Philip's name for the W variant (#0.151 'honki kai' = Philip). #0.152 Momotaros 'Psycho-whatsit' matches story_114 #0.67. 'Yarou' -> 'bastard'.
OOO variant trails off ('iru tte...'): kept the trailing ellipsis.
Cherudim on the radio, reacting to Seravee's plan. 'Houtou' = the cannon's turret/barrel; rendered 'the cannon's turret'.
Seravee asking the team to bet on this chance ('kakete kure'): direction = Seravee asking everyone.

Speaker label says Seravee, but the script (MessWinSet TextIdOffset+158+14, shown after the empty entry #0.158) makes #0.159-173 the 15-slot leader block: #0.159 = 00 (Setsuna), #0.160 = Wing Zero ('if that's the mission' = Heero), #0.161 God, #0.162 Nu, #0.163 Zeta, #0.164 Zero, #0.165 Mebius, #0.166 Taro, #0.167 Seven, #0.168 Ultraman, #0.169 OOO, #0.170 W (Philip), #0.171 Momotaros, #0.172 RX, #0.173 Rider 1. Voiced #0.159 as Setsuna; the line also works if Seravee says it.
No speaker label; script shows Cherudim (CHARA_NAME 71) for TextIdOffset+173. 'Ride Machine' = the party's vehicle (glossary).
'Akumade' -> 'our objective is the particle cannon, and nothing else' (don't get drawn into fighting the Mk-II).
Leader block 0625 #0.1-15 (chain 7,10,9,6,15,14,5,4,3,8,13,12,11,2,1): #0.1-4 Zeta, 00, Wing Zero, Nu (identical), #0.5 Zero, #0.6 Mebius, #0.7 OOO; rest in story_116.

report: 80/80 rows. Leader blocks mapped via Pt_Chara_Check chains in 0618.bla/0625.bla. Flag: #0.159 speaker label Seravee looks shifted by the empty entry #0.158; script order makes it the 00 variant of the 15-slot block (voiced as Setsuna). #0.174 unlabelled, script says Cherudim. Not in glossary: Psycho Gundam Mk-II, particle cannon, Terminal Unit, Veda (all as in earlier slices).
